newsitem.title: INDIA: India castorseed market closed for Moslem festival.
newsitem.headline: India castorseed market closed for Moslem festival.

text.p: The Bombay Oilseeds and Oils Exchange, which conducts futures trading in castorseed, was closed on Friday for the Moslem festival of Eid al-Adha.
On Thursday, castorseed June delivery fell 11 rupees to 1,149/1,150 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative selling.
Arrivals of castorseed in India's western state of Gujarat rose to 60,000 bags (75 kg each) from 45,000 bags reported on Tuesday. The market was closed on Wednesday for a Hindu festival.
In edible oils, groundnut oil rose 10 rupees to 367/368 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals.

Imported palm oil also rose 10 rupees to 294/295 rupees per 10 kg a shortage of ready stock. Delivery after a week was quoted lower at 289/290 rupees per 10 kg as traders expected the arrival of two vessels carrying imported palm oil at Bombay port next week, one broker said.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil gained 15 rupees to 555 rupees per 15 kg.
